summary: The air orders window whole: its four shapes, the cone's test, the right click that aims an area, the sliders, day and night, the dates, accept, the ladder that ticks the first row, what it remembers and the map's colours while it is up.

structs.name: CAirOrdersView
structs.comment: The window of orders an air unit is given, `air_unit_order`, made by CInGameIdler::OpenOrdersView with mode 1. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 1.
structs.evidence: CInGameIdler::OpenOrdersView allocates 0x37C bytes for it; the RTTI export gives the table.

addresses.name: CAirOrdersView::OnAccept
addresses.comment: **Accept.** For each unit of the selection that is an air unit (slot 17), skipping one whose order says yes to slot 24 and no to slot 12 - a change of base under way: a CSetOrderCommand(unit, the type of the order being made, the window's province, the hour the window was opened, the null date), with the view's stance (+0x94) and time (+0x98), the ids of the order's list as objectives, the start widget's date as start_date (+0x74) and as end_date (+0x78) the defines' end_date where continous_checkbox is ticked and the end widget's otherwise; posted, and the window closed (+0x38 cleared). **The priority (+0x2E0) is not sent.** See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 10.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C, 0x742720; the button glue at +0x50, wired to `accept` in the constructor (0x740675).

addresses.name: CAirOrdersView::MakeOrder
addresses.comment: The radio group's glue (+0x174), run when a row is ticked: the order being made (+0x2EC) is destroyed and a new one made by CreateOrder from the ticked name and the window's province, given the view's shape; then CAirOrder::SetSecondTarget(order, +0x34, false), SetAreaAngle, SetAreaWidth and SetAreaRange with the view's three values, and the map redrawn. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C, 0x742AA0; wired at 0x740C1F.

addresses.name: CAirOrdersView::OnPointButton
addresses.comment: `point_target_button`: its own frame 2 and the other three buttons' frame 1, none of the sliders switched on, the view's shape (+0x2E8) and the order's (+0x6C) 0, the order's list made again with CAirOrder::SetSecondTarget(order, +0x34, false), and the map redrawn. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C; the glue wired to the button in the constructor.

addresses.name: CAirOrdersView::ShowAreaFigures
addresses.comment: `range_value` ORDER_RANGE_VAL with VAL the view's range (+0x2F0) `%.0f`; `angle_value` and `width_value` ORDER_ANGLE_VAL and ORDER_WIDTH_VAL with the view's angle and width x 180 / pi, `%.2f`. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C and the listing: movss xmm0, [ecx + 0x2F0] before the formatter 0xA5AEC0, whose format table is %.0f, %.1f, %.2f, %.3f.

addresses.name: CAirOrdersView::UpdateTimeBoxes
addresses.comment: Makes day_checkbox, night_checkbox and both_checkbox one choice by the time last chosen (+0x30C): both ticked from 0 or 1 gives 2, night from 0 or 2 gives 1, day from 1 or 2 gives 0, each clearing the other two; clearing the ticked box changes nothing. Then daytime_title ORDER_DAY_TIME with PROV, and daytime_icon frame 2 at night and 1 by day with daytime_icondesc ORDER_NIGHT or ORDER_DAY, by IsNight of the window's province at the start date's hour of the day and month. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 7.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C, 0x744E50, and the listing for IsNight's province (edi = [ebx + 0x30] at 0x74529D).

addresses.name: CountWingKinds
addresses.no_signature: The unit in ECX and the vector to fill on the stack; answers the vector.
addresses.comment: Counts a unit's wings three ways into a vector of three: [0] a wing whose definition is no bomber (isBomber, +0x37); [2] a bomber whose (soft + hard attack) x 1000 / 2000 is under its strategic attack (+0x17C); [1] any other bomber. BuildOrders' ladder compares the three. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 3.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C, 0x746160.

addresses.name: CAirOrdersView::HoldParadropStart
addresses.comment: For a paradrop being made (type 0x570): the start widget's date is moved on to the hour now and PARADROP_MIN_TIME / 1000 where it is earlier. Called by Update and by accept. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 9.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C, 0x745520.

addresses.name: CAirOrdersView::Update
addresses.comment: Slot 2, each frame. Where an order is being made, each slider's value times its factor - the unit's range / 1000, 2pi, 2pi - is taken where it differs from the view's last by more than 0.05 of itself: stored, passed to SetAreaRange, SetAreaAngle or SetAreaWidth, and the figures and the map redone. accept is switched on only while an order is being made, its list is not empty and COrder slot 10 says yes; otherwise switched off, and second_target reads ORDER_NO_SECOND_TARGET. Then UpdateTimeBoxes, and both date widgets switched off while continous_checkbox is ticked and on while it is not. Answers +0x38, whether the window stays open. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C, 0x741DE0; the factors at 0x160AAD4 (6.2831855) and the unit's +0xC8 +0x148, the threshold at 0x160A510 (0.05).

addresses.name: CAirOrdersView::IsShown
addresses.comment: Slot 3: the window's byte +0x5B. The input handler asks it before giving a right click to slot 4. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 6.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C.

addresses.name: CAirOrdersView::OnMapRightClick
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CAirOrdersView::OnMapRightClick(CAirOrdersView* this, CMapProvince* province, bool shift)
addresses.comment: Slot 4, a right click on a province while the window is up. Circle or cone: CAirOrder::SetSecondTarget(order, province, shift). Point with shift: the order's slot 36 with the province. Region with shift: slot 36 for each province of its first region, or for the province where it has none. Otherwise the window is moved to the province (+0x30), the list made again keeping the order's type, the order made again and the shape's button pressed again. Then the map redrawn. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 6.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C, 0x743950, and its caller at 0x653547 in the input handler, which passes CInGameIdler +0x1C's slot 10 - the shift key - as the flag.

The signature follows CNavalOrdersView::GetTooltip's. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 11.

addresses.name: CAirOrder::SetSecondTarget
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CAirOrder::SetSecondTarget(CAirOrder* this, CMapProvince* province, bool toggle)
addresses.comment: Nothing for the order's own province. With toggle: a province out of range (slot 38) is taken off the list where it is on it; one on the list is taken off; any other added. Without: the list emptied, the second target (+0x54) set, and for a province given the range (+0x74) becomes the distance to it, no more than the unit's range / 1000, and the angle (+0x70) Bearing(the order's province, it); then shape 2 or 3 FillArea from the order's province with floor((range + 0.0005) * 1000), shape 0 the order's province where slot 38 agrees, shape 4 each province of the order's province's first region that slot 38 agrees to, or the order's province with no region. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C, 0x588EB0, and the listing 0x588F90..0x58907D for the bearing's arguments.

addresses.name: AirOrderBearing
addresses.signature: float __cdecl AirOrderBearing(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)
addresses.comment: atan2(y2 - y1, x1 - x2) + 3pi/2 in single precision: with the label points of two provinces, the compass bearing of the second from the first, clockwise from north. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: The listing 0x588E60..0x588EA3: fld [ebp+0x14] - [ebp+0xC], fld [ebp+8] - [ebp+0x10], the CRT atan2 at 0xC0BDBA, fadd qword 0x160A540 (4.712389).

addresses.name: IsWithinArc
addresses.no_signature: Three floats on the stack - the bearing, the angle and the half width; answers a float in XMM0.
addresses.comment: With fmod by 2pi of angle + half, angle - half and the bearing: where the first is above the second the bearing must lie between them, otherwise at or above the second or at or below the first; answers 1.0 or 0.0. fmod keeps a negative angle - half negative, so an arc reaching west of north loses that part. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: The listing 0x589320..0x5893F0: three calls of the CRT fmod at 0xC0892A with qword 0x160A4F0 (6.2831855), the comparisons, and 1.0 (0x171DBAC) or 0 in xmm0.

addresses.name: ProvinceFirstRegion
addresses.comment: The first region of a province's list (CMapProvince +0x358), or null where its count (+0x360) is nought. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C, 0x4A6E90.

addresses.name: DrawAirOrderArea
addresses.no_signature: The order on the stack, the unit's country in EAX (+0x124/+0x128) and the map's colours in EDI (+0x2C, two dwords a province).
addresses.comment: **The map's colours while the air orders window is up.** Every province, fill and stripe alike: out of the unit's range (the order's slot 38) nothing at all; in range, sea or land the unit's country controls (0.6, 0.9, 0.6); land of a country at war with it (0.9, 0.6, 0.6); other land (0.6, 0.6, 0.6); then each province of the order's list (0.5, 0.8, 0.8). Its two callers are the window's constructor and CAirOrdersView::DrawArea. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 8.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C, 0x867DB0: the five static colours (0.4 at fAiCommitmentFactor_0_4, 0.7 at 0x160A2E8, 0.5 at 0x15AB304, 0.8 at 0x174C564, alpha 1 at 0x171DBAC) and the 0.2 at 0x160A260 added to in-range colours.

addresses.name: CMap::AssignRegions
addresses.comment: For each region of the map's vector (+0x2A40..+0x2A44), for each province id of the region's own vector (CRegion +0x8..+0xC) under the map's province count: the region is appended to the province's list (CMapProvince +0x358). Called by the map loader right after CMap::AssignContinents. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C, 0x48FAC0, and the call at 0x48A700.

addresses.name: CAirOrdersView::CAirOrdersView
addresses.signature: CAirOrdersView* __stdcall CAirOrdersView::CAirOrdersView(CAirOrdersView* this, CInGameIdler* idler, CUnit* unit, CMapProvince* province)
addresses.comment: Builds `air_unit_order`: wires accept, cancel, the four shape buttons and the stance and priority arrows; title the province's name; both_checkbox and continous_checkbox ticked, day and night cleared, time 2; BuildOrders(unit, 0x18D) and the order made; two `datewidget`s at mission_timewidget_start and _stop, **the start the hour now and the end a month on**; the map coloured for the order; the sliders set to 0, 16 and 250 thousandths - range, angle, width - and read back; the figures shown. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C and the listing 0x7400C0..0x741420: AddMonths(&date, 1) at 0x740F0F and SetValue with floor of 0.5, 16.5 and 250.5.
addresses.revises: Was read for its element names and the BuildOrders call only.

addresses.name: CAirOrdersView::BuildOrders
addresses.signature: void __stdcall CAirOrdersView::BuildOrders(CAirOrdersView* view, CUnit* unit, int keepToken)
addresses.comment: Makes the window's list of orders, keeping a type: the order being made's, else the unit's own order's where 0x18D is given, else the one given. A row of that type that may be given is noted. Ticked: where the unit may stand in the province, rebase_air if its controller is not at war with the unit's country, it has an air base built and the rebase may be given, else the ladder, then the noted row; elsewhere the noted row, else the ladder. **The ladder**, each rung only where nothing is ticked: fighters outnumbering each kind of bomber - air_superiority over an enemy's province, else air_intercept; a sea attack - port_strike at an owned province with a port and a naval base built, else naval_strike at sea; more strategic bombers than tactical over a province at war - runway_cratering where it has an air base built, else installation_strike where it has a radar station, nuclear reactor or rocket test site, else strategic_bomb where it has IC; a soft or hard attack - ground_attack, else interdiction. Each only where it may be given. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 3.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C, 0x746260 to the end, with CountWingKinds (0x746160).
addresses.revises: Which row is ticked was read only as far as its first rung.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::CloseOrdersView
addresses.comment: Closes the view at +0x160. **An air window's settings are kept first**: CAirOrdersView::SaveSettings into +0x1D9C - priority, stance, shape and the type of the order it was making - which CInGameIdler::OpenOrdersView hands to CAirOrdersView::RestoreSettings when the next air window opens. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: The listing 0x678160..0x6781B6.
addresses.revises: Adds what is kept of an air window.

addresses.name: CAirOrder::FillArea
addresses.no_signature: thiscall with a pointer to the range and the province on the stack; its return was not read off the bytes.
addresses.comment: **Makes a mission's provinces out of a range.** From a province: mark it seen (CMapProvince +0x37C) and add it to the list where slot 38 agrees; then for each neighbour not seen, mark it, remember it on the list at +0x58, and where the unit's slot 35 (CanMoveTo) and the order's slot 38 agree and 1000 x the distance from the order's province to it is within the range, go on from it - for shape 3 only where IsWithinArc(AirOrderBearing(the order's province's label point, its), the angle +0x70, the width +0x78 x 0.5) is not nought. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: The listing 0x589553..0x589632: ebx is the order's province (+0xC), edi the neighbour, the width multiplied by qword 0x160A308 (0.5).
addresses.revises: Reads the cone's test, which was named and not read.
